claims.quote: All people with diabetes advised to receive a trivalent influenza vaccine and not to receive live attenuated influenza vaccine Annual
claims.locator: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee. 4. Comprehensive Medical Evaluation and Assessment of Comorbidities: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl 1)

claims.text: Pneumococcal, never vaccinated: one dose of PCV15 or PCV20.
claims.quote: For those who have never received any pneumococcal vaccine, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention recommends one dose of PCV15 or PCV20
claims.locator: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee. 4. Comprehensive Medical Evaluation and Assessment of Comorbidities: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl 1)

claims.text: Hep B: adults w DM <60 yrs; ≥60 yrs @ clinician discretion.
claims.quote: hepatitis B vaccine is recommended for adults with diabetes aged <60 years. For adults aged ≥60 years, hepatitis B vaccine may be administered at the discretion of the treating clinician
claims.locator: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee. 4. Comprehensive Medical Evaluation and Assessment of Comorbidities: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl 1)

claims.text: COVID-19: updated vax for everyone ≥6 months.
claims.quote: COVID-19 vaccination using an appropriate number of doses of updated vaccines is recommended for everyone aged 6 months and older in the U.S.
claims.locator: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee. 4. Comprehensive Medical Evaluation and Assessment of Comorbidities: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl 1)
